newsitem.title: INDIA: German Bosch to invest $70 mln in India.
newsitem.headline: German Bosch to invest $70 mln in India.

text.p: German electrical engineering group Robert Bosch GmbH will invest $70 million in a fuel injection pump factory in the northwestern Indian state of Rajasthan, a government official said on Friday.

"The plant will be located at Jaipur, and we have already alloted 50 acres of land to the company for this purpose," Rajasthan deputy chief minister Hari Shankar Bhabhra told Reuters. Jaipur is the state capital.

Bhabhra recently returned from a European tour aimed at attracting investment to the state. "Rajasthan is keen to attract investment in auto ancillaries, given the large number of car manufacturers entering India," he said.
The minister said he met senior Bosch officials in Germany.
Bhabhra said Italian automotive conglomerate Fiat Spa was also likely to set up an auto component unit in Rajasthan after company officials visited India to conduct a feasibility study.
Bosch already makes automotive components in India through its subsidiary, Motor Industries Company Ltd.
